description: Get a download URL for a flyer (pdf-print | png) or a brochure (pdf-brochure — an imposed two-page print PDF — | png-brochure). A t-shirt exports as a 300-DPI transparent PNG and a landing page as a self-contained static HTML site. Export sits behind the SAME paid wall a deck export hits, enforced by the server, so open the link in a browser signed in as this account. `face` selects a flyer face; `sheet` selects a brochure sheet (outside/inside) for its png.

face.description: Which face for a flyer png export (default front)

sheet.description: Which sheet for a brochure png (default outside)

name: export_artifact
title: Export an artifact
